Low-level ZwiftRacing.app request

Source: R/zwiftracing.R
zr_get.Rd

zr_get() sends a GET to any ZwiftRacing.app route. path is relative to the host (https://api.zwiftracing.app), e.g. "/api/public/riders/123" or, with a service key, "/api/v2/riders/123". For a "service" client, a path without a leading /api/ is taken as relative to /api/v2, as in earlier versions.

Usage

zr_get(client, path, query = list(), parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zr"))

zr_rider(client, zwift_id, time = NULL, ...)

zr_riders(client, ids, time = NULL, ...)

zr_rider_overview(client, zwift_id, ...)

zr_rider_results(
  client,
  zwift_id,
  days = 365,
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zr")
)

zr_rider_ranking(client, zwift_id, days = 90, ...)

zr_rider_velo(client, zwift_id, days = 365, ...)

zr_rider_power(client, zwift_id, ...)

zr_event(client, event_id, ...)

zr_result(client, event_id, parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zr"))

zr_zp_result(client, event_id, parse = "tbl", ttl = .zv_ttl("zr"))

zr_club(client, club_id, ...)

zr_club_riders(client, club_id, page = NULL, ...)

zr_categories(client, ...)

zr_route_weights(
  client,
  route_id,
  laps = NULL,
  distance = NULL,
  event_type = c("race", "timeTrial"),
  ...
)

zr_routes(client, ...)

Arguments

client

A zr_client().

path

Route path (see Details).

query

Named list of query parameters.

parse

One of "tbl", "json", "resp".

ttl

Cache time-to-live in seconds (0 = off, Inf = permanent).

zwift_id

Zwift rider id.

time

Optional point in time for a historical snapshot.

...

For the typed wrappers, further arguments forwarded to zr_get().

ids

Vector of Zwift rider ids.

days

Look-back window in days.

event_id

Zwift event id.

club_id

Club id.

page

Page number (service key) or rider id to start after (user key), or NULL for every page.

route_id

Zwift route id.

laps, distance

Laps, or distance in metres (exactly one).

event_type

"race" (default) or "timeTrial".

Value

A tibble, parsed list, or httr2 response.

Details

What each key reaches. A user key (the default; Hobby API Access) can call zr_rider(), zr_riders(), zr_club(), zr_club_riders(), zr_result(), zr_zp_result(), zr_categories() and zr_route_weights(), subject to its tier's per-route limits (some may be 0). The rest (zr_rider_overview(), zr_rider_results(), zr_rider_ranking(), zr_rider_velo(), zr_rider_power(), zr_event(), zr_routes()) exist only on the website's v2 routes and need a service key.

Errors. A route your tier has no allowance for fails at once with class zv_zr_no_access; a service-only function called with a user key fails with class zv_zr_service_only. Short rate-limit waits are retried; long ones are reported with the time to wait.

Functions

  • zr_rider(): A rider's profile: vELO rating (velo$race, with velo$factors, velo$category), race counts, power bests (power$w5 ... power$w1200, and w/kg), zFTP, phenotype and club. With time (POSIXct or Unix seconds; user keys only), a snapshot at that moment. Only the legacy ZwiftRacing rating (race$current) is rewound: vELO, power bests and race counts are always current (checked live, 2026-11).

  • zr_riders(): Several riders' profiles, one row each. With a user key this is one POST per 1000 riders (time gives snapshots, as for zr_rider()); with a service key, one request per rider. Riders that are unknown or opted out are simply absent.

  • zr_rider_overview(): Rider overview, including the legacy ZwiftRacing ratings (legacyRatings$live/max30/max90) and rating history. Service key only.

  • zr_rider_results(): A rider's race results over the last days days (90 or 365). One row per race (nested event, place, race, velo, legacy objects, flattened to dotted column names). Service key only.

  • zr_rider_ranking(): A rider's ranking / points over the last days days. Service key only.

  • zr_rider_velo(): A rider's vELO rating history over the last days days. Service key only.

  • zr_rider_power(): A rider's power curve, efforts and FTP estimate. Service key only (a user key's zr_rider() carries the 5 s - 20 min bests).

  • zr_event(): Event metadata (route, distance, pens with summary stats). Service key only.

  • zr_result(): Race results for an event, one row per rider. With a service key this flattens the v2 event's pens and adds a pen column (position, category, time, wkg*, ratings, power.CP, power.AWC, ...). With a user key it reads /api/public/results/:id and returns its records as they come.

  • zr_zp_result(): ZwiftPower's view of an event's results, as served by ZwiftRacing.app (/api/public/zp/:id/results). User key.

  • zr_club(): Club summary. With a user key this is /api/public/clubs/:id, which also carries the first page of riders.

  • zr_club_riders(): Club members with ratings. Service keys page by number (50 riders a page, 0-indexed; page = NULL fetches all). User keys page by rider id (/api/public/clubs/:id/:riderId returns riders with a higher id); page = NULL follows those pages to the end, otherwise page is the rider id to start after (0 for the first page).

  • zr_categories(): The vELO category bands (number, name, min, max) on the 1-1000 scale. User key.

  • zr_route_weights(): How much each ability (endurance, pursuit, sprint, punch, climb, time trial) counts on a route, for a number of laps or a distance in metres (give one). User key.

  • zr_routes(): Route catalogue. Service key only.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zr <- zr_client()
zr_get(zr, "/api/public/riders/1234567")
zr_rider(zr, 1234567)
zr_riders(zr, c(1234567, 2345678))        # one POST for up to 1000 riders
} # }
